title: Faultwake Spire
description: A seven-metre violet blade growing up through a limestone fault with an uplifted bank and a downthrown bank.

review.notes: Round 2. Fixed: spire is a proper prism blade with side crystals; the camouflage pattern is gone; base fault banks are now layered shale plates with a fracture ring and rubble. Not fixed: (1) closeup.jpg shows the material as flat blue-violet with long vertical streaks over the whole blade (reads as a stretched texture) and a bluish top facet; no lighter facets or inner bands - darken to the violet_crystal base, add lighter facet values and internal bands. (2) Main blade termination is still a clean point with no stepped growth or broken edge; the raised collar rings at even spacing look like bamboo joints - make growth steps inset and uneven, chip the edges. (3) The top surfaces of the base slabs show the same wood-grain streaking (closeup_base tile); use a proper rock/limestone pattern at metre scale. (4) Emissive cracks are barely visible; make a few read in the hero view.
